description:
Hushfacebook v0.3.4 brings together all changes since v0.2.0. It targets Facebook 580.0.0.51.74 and retains support for 577.0.0.50.72. The bundle now has 43 patches, up from 27.

## What's new

- **Searchable settings.** A new overview leads to category pages, with search, clearer dialogs and a live preview for saved video names. Dark, light and wallpaper themes are supported.
- **Marketplace only.** Keep Marketplace, Notifications and your profile or Menu in the tab bar. Optional quiet social notifications and feed preloading controls are available, with a way back to regular Facebook. The mode starts off.
- More filtering controls cover suggested Stories and Groups, Menu promotions, sponsored search/profile posts and Marketplace requests. Word lists can hide or keep posts, and creator-labelled AI posts have a separate opt-in switch.
- **Playback and saves.** Tap to play clears the initial play overlay when playback starts and stops a quick swipe from carrying a tap into the next Reel. Long-video resume is available. Compatible saves preserve known H.264/AAC pairs, and audio selection favors formats more players can handle.
- Choose a custom font file, open on a chosen tab, set the default comment order, limit tag suggestions to an explicit @, and block selected promotional notifications. Hushfacebook also has an entry in Facebook's Menu.

## Update

1. Refresh the Hushfacebook source in Morphe Manager 1.32.0 or newer. Review the new patches and select the controls you want.
2. Patch the arm64-v8a, Android 11+ bundle of Facebook **580.0.0.51.74**, build **475019344**. Facebook **577.0.0.50.72**, build **474426275**, is also supported.
3. Install over your current patched Facebook using the manager's existing signing key. Keep that key to preserve update compatibility.

The `.mpp` download is a patch bundle, not a Facebook APK. [Installation instructions](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/Hushfacebook#install).

## Known limitations

Some reports still need checks on the affected phone or viewer: WhatsApp import (#11), Media settings (#12), Xiaomi Gallery audio (#14), cloned-app settings (#16) and a missing Reel Download button (#18). The original reporter's stuck-overlay viewer also needs confirmation. Marketplace can still show ads on listing-detail pages.

Review diagnostic reports before sharing them. Automatic filtering can miss structured credentials or other private text.

## Validation

Local checks passed: 984 runtime tests and 454 patch tests, with no failures or skips, plus both Android lints and the release-script checks. All 43 patches applied without forcing to both supported Facebook builds, with no resource or injected-code structural errors. The dependency advisory check passed.

The rebuilt bundle is byte-for-byte identical to the previously verified v0.3.4 bundle. The existing S22 settings and playback checks apply to the same runtime code; the affected configurations listed above remain unconfirmed.

The release includes the patch bundle, its dependency inventory (SBOM), the build and fixture receipt, and SHA-256 checksums.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/Hushfacebook/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)
